title: Transpose
description: Salvage Enchantments! Turn your enchanted item into an enchanted book.
body:
Salvage your enchantments!\
Rip the good qualities out of a useless object!\
Turn enchanted items into enchanted books.

In a Smithing Table:\
Book and Quill as a template\
The Enchanted Item

Transposed Books work just like Enchanted Books.
